title: Induction on the construction predicate IsGood for the easy direction of Seymour's theorem
intent: Reduce the easy direction of Seymour's theorem — every matroid built from graphic, cographic and R10 matroids by 1-, 2- and 3-sums is regular — to one induction on the construction predicate Matroid.IsGood, with one case per constructor, each closed by the regularity lemma written for that constructor.
also_known_as: structural induction over a construction predicate
induction on an inductive predicate (one lemma per constructor)

children.closed_by: obtain ⟨X, Y, A, hA, hMA⟩ := hM; exact ⟨X, Y, A, hA.isTotallyUnimodular, hMA⟩
children.note: Leaf for the graphic constructor: unfolds IsGraphic to a totally-unimodular matrix representation, which is exactly IsRegular. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A graphic matroid is regular

children.name: Matroid.isRegular_mapEquiv_iff
children.statement: lemma Matroid.isRegular_mapEquiv_iff {α β : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (e : α ≃ β) : (M.mapEquiv e).IsRegular ↔ M.IsRegular
children.closed_by: constructor <;> intro ⟨X, Y, A, hA, hAM⟩; reindex the representation (A.reindex) along e and e.symm, then aesop
children.note: Leaf for the isomorphicR10 constructor: regularity is invariant under mapEquiv, so the R10 matroid's regularity transfers to any isomorphic copy. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Regularity is preserved under remapping

applicability.goal_shape: ∀ M, M.IsGood → P M, where IsGood is an inductive construction predicate (leaf constructors graphic/cographic/isomorphicR10, fork constructors is1sum/is2sum/is3sum) and P is a property of Matroid α (here IsRegular).
applicability.use_when: a property P is already proved for each leaf constructor and preserved by each fork constructor, so the induction has exactly one case per constructor and each closes by the regularity lemma written for that constructor.
applicability.avoid_when: some constructor's case needs genuinely new work, or a leaf's regularity lemma is missing. The fork cases each demand a RankFinite side condition plus two inductive hypotheses, so the sum lemmas must be stated to take those hypotheses; if they are not, the induction stalls on the fork cases.

consequences: The induction creates one goal per constructor of IsGood (three leaves, three forks). Each fork case carries two inductive hypotheses (ihₗ, ihᵣ) and a RankFinite hypothesis, all fed to the matching sum lemma; each leaf case is closed by a regularity lemma for that leaf (graphic, cographic, R10-up-to-mapEquiv). Failure mode: the induction closes only if a regularity lemma exists per constructor and the sum lemmas' side conditions are supplied by the constructor's own hypotheses; a constructor whose property is not already a lemma leaves that case open.
